definition: Audited standalone profit for the full year after tax. This is not mine-level profit, coal output or total comprehensive income.

rows.name: Coal mining and related services · whole company

location: PDF page9 · annual financial-results table; page14 Note2 · single segment; page5 · auditor emphasis matters
notes: Full-year annual March 31, 2026 column, not the March quarter. Source is already ₹ crore. The issuer reports no separate reportable segments, so no mine, washery, coking/non-coking profit split is inferred. Auditor emphasis matters include changed GST/certain levy accounting, pending store-verification impact and partially confirmed/reconciled balances. Certain coal levies are now included in revenue on a principal basis; year comparisons need the reporting-policy notes. Other income and mining inventory/stripping adjustments also affect the profit figure.
insight: Company sales leave a much smaller reported annual net profit after all costs. Read coal dispatches, pricing, mining adjustments and cash collection with these totals; they cannot tell us which mine or washery is most profitable.
